intro: Pull up a chair that feels good from first sip to last bite. Garnet’s mid back, soft foam seat, and frame support your posture and your style, while open space below makes cleaning simple.

features.title: Mid-back support for relaxed posture
features.text: The mid-back profile follows your spine so you sit upright without stiffness, keeping shoulders easy and conversations flowing through long dinners, game nights, or WFH lunches at the table.

features.title: Soft foam seat that welcomes you
features.text: 28D foam cushions the seat so you feel supported rather than perched, making everyday meals and extended chats equally comfortable for you and your guests. You stay comfy longer.

features.title: Rubber wood frame built to last
features.text: Solid rubber wood construction adds dependable strength for day-to-day use, handling the bustle of family dining while keeping its poised, polished look over time. Seasoned wood resists insects.

features.title: Ash fabric seat that blends in
features.text: The ash-toned fabric softens the look and pairs naturally with light or dark tables, helping you refresh your setting without replacing everything around it. The neutral tone pairs with your décor.

features.title: Knockdown design made for moves
features.text: Delivered knockdown to pass tight doors and elevators, then assembled sturdy at home, it’s a chair that moves with you as life and layouts change. Assembly stays simple, even in small spaces.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
